answer: Primary result: **BCG vaccination is not significantly associated with COVID-19 severity. Adjusted BCG OR = 1.27 (95% CI 0.84–1.92, p=0.25)** from the prespecified proportional-odds cumulative-logit model on the 5-level outcome (0 = no COVID-19 AE; 1–4 = max AESEV of the subject's COVID-19 AEs; N=959 complete cases), controlling for prior medical history count (OR 1.22, 95% CI 1.05–1.41, p=0.008), patients_seen (OR 2.42, 95% CI 1.58–3.70, p<0.0001), the BCG×patients_seen interaction (**OR 0.69, 95% CI 0.37–1.31, p=0.26**), and Age/SEX/RACE. With the interaction in the model, the BCG OR is 1.27 at patients_seen "1-50", 0.88 at "51-100", and 0.61 at ">100" — a non-significant attenuation toward protection at higher patient-exposure frequency. The proportional-odds assumption was not rejected (nominal-BCG LRT χ²=6.83, df=3, p=0.078); the partial-PO alternative shows unstable cutpoint-specific BCG ORs (1.27, 1.19, 4.58, 2.44) driven by the 8+6 severe cases. Every prespecified sensitivity analysis (collapse 3+4, COVID-subjects-only, explicit-missing modal/worst-case handling of the 41 unknown-severity COVID subjects, MH-count definition variants, alternative interactions incl. a significant MHcount×patients_seen term OR 1.42 p=0.006, expect_interact in place of/alongside patients_seen, broad COVID definition, adding education/work_hours) leaves the conclusion unchanged: BCG ORs range 0.93–1.28 and none is significant. Cross-check: R was unavailable, so an independently coded scipy cumulative-logit MLE was used — betas agree with statsmodels to 2.2e-3 (llf −532.4053 vs −532.4054). Carried assumptions (not silently resolved): AESEV 1–4 is the severity field with 4 most severe (all fatal events carry 4; labels undocumented); "no COVID-19 AE" is the lowest outcome level; MH count = MEDICAL HISTORY rows with MHORRES==2 (1=No/2=Yes inferred; excludes nothing materially — "Current respiratory tract infection" was never endorsed with code 2); "patients interaction frequency" = patients_seen; "interaction between terms" = BCG×patients_seen; the 41 COVID-19 subjects with entirely missing AESEV are dropped in the primary model (complete case) with modal- and worst-case imputation as sensitivities. Full tables in notes/results.md; executed script analysis_task008.py; raw output notes/full_out.txt and notes/results_raw.txt.
